segments.intent: Calculate the count and average instant-booking rate for Columbus listings by neighbourhood
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT neighbourhood, COUNT(*) AS listing_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN instant_bookable = 't' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS average_instant_booking_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN instant_bookable = 't' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS instant_bookable_count FROM listings WHERE city = 'Columbus' GROUP BY neighbourhood ORDER BY average_instant_booking_rate DESC, neighbourhood
```
